_about: The polity series Atlas v2 Phase 2d adds for the war sides (docs/atlas-v2-design.md §7 'Phase 2d — as built'). Same shape as .claude/polity-spec.json's `polities` and `links`, kept in a file of its own so v1's polity builder and its tests (build-polities.js, test-polities.js, which read polity-spec.json) are untouched. build-history.js reads both; `cliopatria` names Cliopatria v0.2.0 (CC BY 4.0) rows; `years` clips the series to the span the linked cards need. `links`: a card id -> { v: [series keys], l: [series keys] } for a war's two sides, as polity-spec.json does.
